properties.property: Identity precompile output MUST be byte-for-byte identical to input
properties.rationale: Core functionality - identity precompile copies input to output unchanged

properties.property: Identity precompile MUST accept any arbitrary input data without validation
properties.rationale: Identity precompile is designed to accept any bytes - no format restrictions

properties.property: Gas MUST be charged before data is copied to output
properties.rationale: Prevents resource consumption without payment if gas runs out mid-execution

properties.property: Identity gas cost MUST equal GAS_IDENTITY + (GAS_IDENTITY_WORD * ceil32(len)/32)
properties.formal_specification: FORALL input: gas_cost(input) == GAS_IDENTITY + GAS_IDENTITY_WORD * ceil(ceil32(len(input)) / 32)
properties.rationale: Gas formula ensures cost scales linearly with input size in 32-byte words

properties.property: Word count calculation MUST use ceil32 to round up to nearest 32-byte boundary
properties.rationale: Partial words are charged as full words to prevent gas undercharging

properties.property: Zero-length input MUST only charge base gas cost GAS_IDENTITY
properties.rationale: Empty input has zero words, so per-word cost component is zero

properties.property: Identity precompile output inherits trust level of input - no validation performed
properties.rationale: Callers must not assume identity precompile validates or sanitizes data

properties.property: Gas cost MUST bound memory allocation to prevent resource exhaustion
properties.rationale: Large inputs must cost enough gas to prevent memory exhaustion attacks

properties.property: ModExp gas cost MUST be at least 200 regardless of input parameters
properties.rationale: Minimum floor prevents spam attacks with trivially small inputs

properties.property: Multiplication complexity MUST be computed as ceil(max(base_len, mod_len)/8)^2
properties.rationale: Complexity grows quadratically with operand size to reflect actual bigint multiplication cost

properties.property: Final gas MUST be floor(complexity * iteration_count / GQUADDIVISOR) with divisor=3
properties.formal_specification: FORALL params: gas == max(200, floor(complexity * iteration_count / 3))
properties.rationale: Division by 3 aligns gas cost with empirical bigint library performance

properties.property: Zero exponent MUST result in iteration count of 0
properties.rationale: No iterations needed when exponent is zero (result is always 1)

properties.property: Non-zero small exponent (<=32 bytes) iteration count MUST be bit_length(exp) - 1
properties.formal_specification: FORALL exp: exp > 0 AND exp_len <= 32 => iteration_count == bit_length(exp) - 1
properties.rationale: Iteration count reflects number of bit operations in square-and-multiply

properties.property: Large exponent (>32 bytes) iteration count MUST include length factor
properties.rationale: Large exponents need additional iterations for bytes beyond first 32

properties.property: Gas MUST be deducted before modexp computation begins
properties.rationale: Prevents resource consumption without payment if gas check fails

properties.property: Insufficient gas MUST cause call to revert without executing modexp
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: available_gas < modexp_gas(call) => call_reverts AND !computation_executed
properties.rationale: Gas-bound safety - no computation without sufficient payment

properties.property: ModExp result MUST equal base^exponent mod modulus
properties.formal_specification: FORALL b, e, m: modexp(b, e, m) == b^e mod m
properties.rationale: Correctness of cryptographic primitive is essential

properties.property: Minimum 200 gas floor MUST prevent spam with trivial inputs
properties.rationale: Without floor, attackers could spam ModExp with near-zero gas cost

properties.property: Gas cost MUST accurately reflect bigint library computation time
properties.rationale: Underpriced gas enables DoS by consuming disproportionate computation

properties.property: First injecting wallet MUST create window.evmproviders if not exists
properties.rationale: Namespace must exist before any provider can register

properties.property: Provider injection MUST add ProviderWithInfo to window.evmproviders[wallet_name]
properties.rationale: Standard location enables DApp discovery of multiple wallets

properties.property: Multiple wallet providers MUST coexist without overwriting each other
properties.formal_specification: FORALL w1, w2: w1.name != w2.name => inject(w1) AND inject(w2) => both_accessible
properties.rationale: Multi-wallet support requires non-conflicting namespace keys

properties.property: DApp enumeration MUST return all registered providers
properties.rationale: DApps must be able to discover all available wallets for user choice

properties.property: Provider info MUST contain uuid, name, icon, and description fields
properties.formal_specification: FORALL provider: provider.info HAS uuid AND name AND icon AND description
properties.rationale: Metadata enables DApps to display meaningful wallet selection UI

properties.property: User MUST explicitly select wallet provider before DApp uses it
properties.formal_specification: FORALL dapp, provider: use_provider(dapp, provider) => user_selected(provider)
properties.rationale: Prevents DApps from automatically using wallets without user consent

properties.property: SVG icon data from wallet MUST be treated as untrusted input
properties.formal_specification: FORALL icon: icon.source == EXT-WALLET-EXTENSION => icon.trust_level == UNTRUSTED
properties.rationale: Wallet extensions can provide malicious SVG with embedded scripts

properties.property: Icon MUST be validated as base64-encoded SVG data URI format
properties.rationale: Validates icon is in expected format before rendering

properties.property: SVG icons MUST be rendered via tag to prevent XSS
properties.formal_specification: FORALL icon: render(icon) USES NOT inline_svg
properties.rationale: IMG tag execution context prevents JavaScript in SVG from running

properties.property: Embedded JavaScript in SVG icons MUST NOT execute
properties.rationale: XSS prevention - malicious scripts in icons must be neutralized

properties.property: Provider key SHOULD match snake_case format [a-z0-9_]+
properties.rationale: Consistent naming convention enables predictable namespace access

properties.property: Provider UUID MUST be valid UUIDv4 format
properties.rationale: UUID provides unique, consistent identifier across wallet versions

properties.property: Provider MUST implement EIP-1193 interface
properties.rationale: EIP-1193 compliance ensures DApps can interact with provider

properties.property: UUID MUST be consistent across wallet versions but unique per wallet product
properties.formal_specification: FORALL version1, version2: same_wallet_product(version1, version2) => version1.uuid == version2.uuid
properties.rationale: Enables DApps to identify wallet across updates without collision

properties.property: Wallet extensions MUST be intentionally installed by user
properties.rationale: Malicious extensions could inject fake wallets to phish users

properties.property: All EIP-1193 security considerations MUST apply to discovered providers
properties.rationale: Provider interaction security is inherited from EIP-1193 spec
